purpose: API LIST-PRICE equivalents used to turn telemetry tokens into comparable dollars. AAW normally runs on subscription quota (NO_EXTRA_PAID_USAGE), so this is a relative cost yardstick, not a bill. A cost reported by the provider (Claude CLI total_cost_usd) always wins over an estimate. null = unknown: the call stays UNPRICED and the price-independent proxy_units are used instead.
